note: Third pass (owner 2026-11-15). Sebring rebuilt with the official length; tracks that failed before retried. Lausitz: the DEKRA test oval and slalom areas are not part of any lap, and several loops fit the DTM length, so only the single loop that drives the one-way raceway pieces in their mapped direction is accepted. Snetterton: the FIA list carries only the 1997-2010 lap (3.141 km); British GT races the Snetterton 300 circuit.

tracks.tolNote: No piece is missing: every raceway way is on the lap and no way end is open (gap closing 30 m). The map is short everywhere by the same share: full lap 5,887 m vs 6,019 m (-2.2 %), Johnson Club Circuit loop 2,688 m vs 2,736 m (-1.8 %), School Circuit loop 3,140 m vs 3,219 m (-2.5 %). The shape is kept and the lap is scaled to the official length.
One closed map way (4,633 m) plus the start/finish piece: loop 4,640 m, 0.73 % shorter than the FIA 4.674 km (same tolerance practice as Phillip Island 0.7 %)
